content_of_post_to_comment: Debates are generally dumb and only done for the novelty. If you wanted to learn from humans what the best chess moves are, you wouldn’t learn it from a blitz tournament, you’d learn it from giving the best players all the time they needed to find the best moves. You’d allow them to go back and undo mistakes once found. Debates are a poor way to find what’s true. They’re a great way to find out who a good debater is. When a podcast I like has a debate, I usually skip that episode.
